intensity.formula: I(B, L, γ) = B (γ+1) (2N + 4 n_layer L d) / (N b_w + B M_KV(L)),  M_KV(L) = 2 n_layer n_kv d_head L b_kv
intensity.note: our derivation, with W3's bookkeeping (outline W11, 〈關鍵數學〉 3). B* and L_c use the two roofs measured in W11 demo 1 (a) on bf16 weights (key 'measured'); the 4-bit line uses the same two roofs with 4.5 bits per weight.

dettmers_4bit.claim: more than 35,000 experiments; 4-bit almost universally optimal

chen_pitfalls.setup: five eviction policies (StreamingLLM, SnapKV, TOVA, H2O, K-Norm); Llama3 8B and Qwen2.5 14B; 541 prompts of a modified IFEval; only the query is compressed; greedy decoding; leakage measured with ROUGE-L recall
pitfalls: Instructions do not degrade at the same rate under KV compression.
The effects of KV cache compression highly depend on eviction policy and model.
KV cache compression leads to system prompt leakage.
Order of instructions heavily impacts the performance of instruction following.
KV cache eviction disproportionally targets certain instructions, often causing them to be ignored by the LLM.
Eviction corresponding to the wrong tokens can play a critical role in degradation.

demo2.src: W11 demo 2, runs/rehearsal/sweep.json (2026-11-27T09:24 to 11:49; Apple M5 Max; mlx 0.32.2, mlx-lm 872ae88); mlx-lm speculative_generate_step: a draft token is kept if the target's own sample at that position is the same token
demo2.note: alpha = drafts kept / drafts actually checked (the kept ones plus the first rejected one of each round). Speed-up = tokens/s with the draft / tokens/s of the target alone on the same prompts, prefill excluded. One run per cell; the target alone was 10% slower at the end of the run than at the start.
